name: at_least_as_long_as_coind
statement: Seq α} {b : Seq β} (motive : Seq α → Seq β → Prop) (base : motive a b) (step : ∀ a b, motive a b → (∀ b_hd b_tl, (b = .cons b_hd b_tl) → ∃ a_hd a_tl, a = .cons a_hd a_tl ∧ motive a_tl b_tl)) : b.length' ≤ a.length'
